items.title: UTokyo-led team reports physics-based AI computing on light using a 200 m optical fiber
items.summary_en: A University of Tokyo press release, as summarized by search results, describes a physics-based AI approach that runs computation on light. It uses a 200-meter optical fiber and a small number of electronic components. The team says it could eventually reduce the energy and cooling needs of AI data centers.
items.source_name: University of Tokyo (Focus, press release) 'Let there be light'
items.notes: Page not read directly (fetch failed). Details and the 2026-11-05 date come from a web-search summary, and the URL-to-article match is inferred from the title 'Let there be light', so verify both. The work is reportedly published in Nature Computational Science, so it is likely peer-reviewed. The journal paper link was not seen. Original language: English.

items.title: Tokyo Forum 2026 on AI as a transformative technology to be held Nov 20-21
items.summary_en: The University of Tokyo announced Tokyo Forum 2026, themed 'AI as a Transformative Technology: Humanity, Knowledge, and Civilization'. It runs on 20-21 November 2026. Listed speakers include Masahiko Abe (UTokyo), Ren Ito (Sakana AI) and Anne Bouverot (France's Special Envoy for AI).
items.notes: Event announcement, not a research result. The announcement's publication date is unknown. 2026-11-14 is the run date used as a placeholder, so verify it. Content comes from a search summary, not a direct fetch. Related pages: https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/focus/en/events/z1311_00011.html and https://www.tokyoforum.tc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/en/index.html. Original language: English. The event falls after the window, so it is a forward-looking item.

items.title: RIKEN AIP Distinguished Lecture by Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on lifelong memory in LLMs
items.summary_en: RIKEN AIP listed a Distinguished Lecture by Prof. Haim Sompolinsky (Harvard / Hebrew University) titled 'Lifelong Memory in Large Language Models'. According to search results, it was scheduled for 5 November 2026. This is an event listing only, with no findings reported.
items.notes: The date is the scheduled event date, not a verified posting date. Content is from a search summary. No talk recording or slides were confirmed. Original language: English.

items.title: RIKEN AIP news list: NeurIPS 2026 acceptances, trilateral AI symposium talks, an award
items.summary_en: Per a search summary of the RIKEN AIP news listing, AIP reported 81 papers accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Center Director Masashi Sugiyama and Team Director Takayuki Osa spoke at the Trilateral AI Symposium 2026 (27-28 Oct). Team Director Mihoko Otake received the Women in AI APAC Awards 2026 AI for Social Good Award.
items.notes: This is an index page, and the individual item pages and exact dates were not seen. 2026-11-14 is a placeholder date. Some items are likely from before the 2026-11-04 window (the symposium was 27-28 Oct). The 81-paper count is unverified. Original language: English, with a Japanese version likely. Verify before use.
